items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: The name 'Joan' appears only as the person the interviewee is addressing ('You got more questions, Joan?'). No personal relationship or interaction history is described.

ctx.x: They didn't have gambling on those both, did they? No, no, they didn't gamble. Private, you know, some of them guys would get together and while they were waiting to bring the people back they'd play cards and things like that, you know. They'd socialize them. You ready to hear a little racket? Yeah, sure. Why not? What I was thinking was that she could play something, and you could tell me who you think they'd like. Okay. Because so many guys would pick up a little leg from, from, from. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.…
Yeah, I want to go back a little bit to Pensacola and I wanted to ask you about some people that you might have heard playing there. Did you know a piano player by the name of Willie Woods?
